camera._source_note: auto = an Intel RealSense when one is connected, else the webcam below. realsense | webcam to force one.

realsense._note: Colour + depth aligned to it; the mode follows the USB link. D415 limits: colour 60 fps up to 960x540 (30 at 1280x720), depth 90 fps up to 848x480 (30 at 1280x720), and a USB 2 link only manages 640x480 at 15. A mode the camera doesn't offer falls back to the fastest one no larger. preset: a D400 visual preset name (Default, Hand, High Accuracy, High Density, Medium Density) or null to leave it. latency_s: extra delay on top of the frame's own exposure timestamp.
realsense._reset_note: Power-cycle the camera on start (~4 s): a D415 stopped or killed earlier often streams no frames until reset or replugged. A start that is refused or sends no frames is retried (with a reset) up to start_tries times.

camera._latency_note: Exposure -> frame-delivered delay. A frame's capture time = read time - latency_s. Fine-tune by eye with [ / ] in Unity's Mirror mode.

screen._note: Lit picture area of the display behind the two-way glass: Dell U2722D (27in, 596.7 x 335.7 mm, 2560x1440) mounted portrait. Mirror-frame origin = lower-left corner. (The 14in MacBook Pro's own screen: 0.302 x 0.196 m, 3024x1964.)
screen._lean_note: How far the glass leans back (top further from the user), degrees. Garments fall along the real vertical.
screen._scale_note: Size of the mirror output's picture, about the user's chest (1 = as computed).

camera_pose._note: Camera optical centre in Mirror frame (metres: x right, y up, z out of the glass towards the user) and downward pitch relative to the glass. Measured on the mirror: 6 5/8 in right, 24 1/4 in up, 1/8 in out. With a RealSense, measure to its colour (RGB) lens, not the middle of the bar. (The MacBook's own camera: [0.151, 0.204, 0.0].)
camera_pose._tilt_note: Downward pitch relative to the glass (which leans back 6 degrees). Tilt, pos_m[0] and screen.picture_scale were set by eye against the reflection on 2026-11-17 with the mirror output's calibration keys (arrows, U / D); the tape measure gave x = 0.168.

depth._note: Weight of the Depth Anything metric estimate vs the BlazePose skeleton-scale estimate when fusing user distance (webcam only). *_surface_offset_m: depth from the measured body surface back to the joint centre.

compute._note: backend: auto (ONNX Runtime if installed, else OpenVINO) | onnx | openvino. *_device: auto | ane (Apple Neural Engine) | gpu (Apple GPU, NVIDIA TensorRT/CUDA, DirectML) | cpu. auto = ane on Macs, gpu with NVIDIA, else cpu. *_threads: CPU inference thread budgets (only used when a model runs on the CPU), 0 = auto (depth half the cores). Kept small: big pools burn battery for ~1 ms. Depth is capped because the distance it feeds is smoothed at < 1 Hz; depth_idle_hz applies when nobody is tracked.

filters._note: PosePredictor: One-Euro at rest, constant-velocity Kalman (accel_std, m/s^2) once the smoothed speed passes gate_speed (m/s). meas_std = landmark noise per Mirror axis (m).

predict._note: Sent to Unity, which extrapolates the pose to each rendered frame's display time: x + v*tau*(1-exp(-h/tau)), h <= max_horizon_s. blend_tc_s eases the hand-over when a new perception frame arrives.

shape._note: The user's build, measured from the depth camera (bodyshape.py): torso half-width and half-depth at six heights, a 16 x 5 mould of the torso's front and the shoulder tops, averaged over time_constant_s while they face the camera (max_turn: shoulder depth difference / shoulder width). Garments are cut to it. Needs a RealSense; with a webcam the renderer uses the person mask's silhouette instead.

gestures._note: swipe distances / speeds are in shoulder widths (sw) in the 2D image, so they don't depend on distance. swipe_direction: natural = like scrolling (move the hand right to bring in the item on the left), pointer = the opposite.

net._mirror_port_note: second renderer: the mirror output (garments alone on black). It gets the pose and the person mask, not the camera images. 0 = off
net._mask_note: person-mask width sent to Unity for occlusion (0 = off)
